name: 60467 · Orland Park, IL
findings: ZIP 60467 (Orland Park) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60467 (Orland Park) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
